Unser flexibler Ansatz für die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, stellt die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit der Menschen in den Vordergrund und fördert das Engagement und die Karrieremöglichkeiten. Wir geben engagierten Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln und ihren eigenen Weg innerhalb des Unternehmens zu gehen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft, indem wir unsere globalen Teams dazu bringen, als „One Kelvion “ zu handeln.KelvionAt Kelvion, our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

International PhD Opportunities in Security and PrivacyInternational Max Planck Research School (IMPRS) for Privacy-Enhancing Technologies for the Digital SocietyMax Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) & Ruhr University Bochum (RUB), GermanyShape the Future of Digital Security and PrivacyThe International Max Planck Research School (IMPRS) for Privacy-Enhancing Technologies for the Digital Society invites applications from outstanding candidates worldwide for doctoral research in computer security, privacy, and related fields.The IMPRS is a joint initiative of the Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) and Ruhr University Bochum (RUB). The program brings together leading researchers across complementary disciplines and provides a structured doctoral training environment combining fundamental research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and international scientific exchange.We welcome candidates interested in one or more of the following areas:Post-quantum cryptography for privacy-enhancing technologiesSecure and privacy-preserving systems’ infrastructureResponsible privacy-preserving system buildingHuman-centered privacy-preserving technologiesPrivacy in machine learning applicationsTo be eligible to enroll in IMPRS, you should:Have or be about to receive a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant ﬁeld related to Security, Privacy, or Computer ScienceHave an outstanding academic recordGood English skillsAdmission to the program will be based on a comprehensive review of application materials, including academic transcripts, statements of research interest, and letters of reference, supplemented by (remote) interviews.Fully funded doctoral research positions.Research opportunities with internationally recognized faculty at MPI-SP and RUB.Individual scientiﬁc supervision, structured doctoral training, and career mentoring.Opportunities for interdisciplinary collaborations, international conferences, research visits, and industry research internships.A vibrant scientiﬁc community fostering independent thinking, innovation, and professional development.Two entry pathways: Bachelor's graduates enter a preparatory phase alongside the Fast-Track PhD at RUB, followed by the doctoral research phase. Master's graduates enter directly into the doctoral research phase.Equal OpportunitiesThe Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy stands for a collaborative, diverse and inclusive workplace culture and promotes equal opportunities. We strongly encourage applications from members of any underrepresented group in our research area. In particular, we invite and motivate women and individuals with disabilities to apply.

At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. jobs.description: PhD Student (f/m/d) Bridging Fluid Dynamics and Laser–Plasma Physics: Modeling Cryogenic Hydrogen Sheet JetsWith cutting-edge research in the fields of ENERGY, HEALTH and MATTER, around 1,500 employees from more than 70 nations at Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf (HZDR) are committed to mastering the great challenges facing society today.This position is based within the Institute of Radiation Physics and the Institute of Fluid Dynamics:The Institute of Radiation Physics conducts research for states of matter under extreme conditions and in very small dimensions.The Institute of Fluid Dynamics is conducting basic and applied research in the fields of thermo-fluid dynamics and magnetohydrodynamics in order to improve the sustainability, the energy efficiency and the safety of industrial processes.We are looking for a PhD Student (f/m/d) Bridging Fluid Dynamics and Laser–Plasma Physics: Modeling Cryogenic Hydrogen Sheet Jets. Your tasks- Develop and implement a numerical simulation approach in OpenFOAM Foundation software to model the evolution of cryogenic fluid jets- Design parametrizable 3D computational models to investigate jet morphology and stability- Conduct experimental testing of manufactured apertures to verify simulation results- Optimize geometric parameters of the jet source to achieve specific flow characteristics for experimental applicationsYour profile- Completed university studies (Master/Diploma) in the field of Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering or Physics- A strong interest in fluid mechanics, with a particular focus on computational fluid dynamics and a willingness to learn openFOAM- Motivation to combine simulation work with experimental validation- Familiarity with optical setups, microscopy, or cryogenic technologies is an advantage- Strong communication skills to facilitate effective collaboration between two institutes- Ability to work independently and in a structured, goal-oriented manner- A keen interest in interdisciplinary challenges at the intersection of physics and engineering- Interest in programming with C++ and Python- Very good written and verbal communication skills in EnglishOur offer- A vibrant research community in an open, diverse and international work environment- Scientific excellence and extensive professional networking opportunities- A structured PhD program with a comprehensive range of continuing education and networking opportunities - more information about the PhD program at the HZDR can be found here (https://www.hzdr.de/db/Cms?pNid=1908)- Salary and social benefits in accordance with the collective agreement for the public sector (TVöD-Bund) including 30 days of paid holiday leave, company pension scheme (VBL)- Depending on the personal qualifications, the candidate may be classified in salary group 13 according to TVöD-Bund- We support a good work-life balance with the possibility of part-time employment, mobile working and flexible working hours- Numerous company health management offerings- Employee discounts with well-known providers via the platform Corporate Benefits- An employer subsidy for the "Deutschland-Ticket Jobticket"We look forward to receiving your application documents (including cover letter, CV, diplomas/transcripts, etc.), which you can submit via our online-application-system.
